resources.string: Falcon gathering starts with road-test recording and stops with it. Stopping also removes the live matched path. Browsing the map does not upload a track.
Use AMap Falcon to denoise and match driving tracks to roads. Enabling this uploads location tracks to AMap; raw points and dual-SIM measurements are kept separately.

No route import required. Cyan shows cloud corrections. Recorded points show time-aligned corrections while raw positions and signal measurements remain saved. Driving roads are supported; railways and subways are not.
Trajectory correction has not been configured. Contact your administrator.
This recording has no Falcon track metadata. Showing the raw road-test points.
Showing the recording’s Falcon track. Replay does not upload historical points or collect live locations.

Falcon collects every 2 seconds, syncs every 10 seconds and queries the last 3 minutes about every 15 seconds. The status shows the returned cloud point count. Delayed results update recorded points by measurement time while raw coordinates and dual-SIM signals remain saved. IMU estimates are not forced onto roads; old cloud points never move the current marker. Replay also saves available corrections. Railway and subway correction is not supported.
Cloud connection unavailable; retrying automatically. Raw locations and road-test recording continue.
Falcon unavailable (code %1$d); retrying automatically. Raw locations and recording continue.
